\[ 27 \times 37,000 = 27 \times (37 \times 1,000) = (27 \times 37) \times 1,000 \]

\[ 27 \times 30 = 810 \]
\[ 27 \times 7 = 189 \]
\[ 810 + 189 = 999 \]

So, \(27 \times 37 = 999\). Therefore:

\[ 27 \times 37,000 = 999 \times 1,000 = 999,000 \]

ANSWER:
999,000 miles
